15	码点升序；每笔匹配交易只归入一个对手（发送方为观察地址时归
16	to_address，接收方为观察地址时归 from_address，自转账归观察地址本身）。
17	time-stats 把匹配交易按从 Unix 纪元对齐、左闭右开的固定宽度时间区间
18	分桶，只返回非空区间，按 bucket_start 升序分页。
19	pair-stats 把匹配交易按 from_address 到 to_address 的原字符串有向
20	组合分组（自转账也累计一次），顺序为 total_amount 降序、total_count
21	降序、from_address 码点升序、to_address 码点升序。
22	address-time-stats 先按从 Unix 纪元对齐、左闭右开的固定宽度时间区间
23	分桶，再按参与地址在各区间内聚合（口径与 address-stats 相同），只
24	返回非空（区间, 地址）组，顺序为 bucket_start 升序、total_amount
25	降序、total_count 降序、send_count 降序、receive_count 降序、
26	address 码点升序。
27	分页：不透明 keyset 游标（见 :mod:`tx_indexer.cursor`），相同命令与
28	筛选下不跳过、不重复、不乱序；``total`` / ``total_groups`` 始终为
29	全部匹配数 / 全部分组数。

71	def _normalize_value_set(name, values):
72	    """把单个值或值迭代器归一化为去重后的 frozenset；空集合返回 None。"""
73	    if values is None:
74	        return None
75	    if isinstance(values, str):
76	        values = (values,)
77	    result = set()
78	    for value in values:
79	        if not isinstance(value, str) or value.strip() == "":
80	            raise InvalidFilterError(
81	                "%s 筛选值不能为空或仅含空白" % name, None
82	            )
83	        result.add(value)
84	    if not result:
85	        return None
86	    return frozenset(result)

89	def normalize_filters(address=None, method=None, start_time=None, end_time=None,
90	                      from_address=None, to_address=None):
91	    """校验并归一化筛选条件。
92	
93	    ``method`` / ``from_address`` / ``to_address`` 接受单个字符串或
94	    字符串迭代器，归一化为去重集合（frozenset）；不给或为空则为 None。
95	    """
96	    if address is not None and (
97	        not isinstance(address, str) or address.strip() == ""
98	    ):
99	        raise InvalidFilterError(
100	            "address 筛选值不能为空或仅含空白", None
101	        )
102	    from_set = _normalize_value_set("from_address", from_address)
103	    to_set = _normalize_value_set("to_address", to_address)
104	    method_set = _normalize_value_set("method", method)
105	    if address is not None and (from_set is not None or to_set is not None):
106	        raise InvalidFilterError(
107	            "address 不能与 from_address / to_address 同时使用", None
108	        )
109	    for name, value in (("start_time", start_time), ("end_time", end_time)):
110	        if value is not None and (
111	            not isinstance(value, int) or isinstance(value, bool) or value < 0
112	        ):
113	            raise ValueError("%s 必须为非负整数" % name)
114	    if start_time is not None and end_time is not None and start_time > end_time:
115	        raise InvalidTimeRangeError(
116	            "时间窗倒置：start_time(%d) 大于 end_time(%d)"
117	            % (start_time, end_time),
118	            None,
119	        )
120	    return {
121	        "address": address,
122	        "from_address": from_set,
123	        "to_address": to_set,
124	        "method": method_set,
125	        "start_time": start_time,
126	        "end_time": end_time,
127	    }

130	def _matches(record, filters):
131	    if filters["address"] is not None:
132	        addr = filters["address"]
133	        if record["from_address"] != addr and record["to_address"] != addr:
134	            return False
135	    if (
136	        filters["from_address"] is not None
137	        and record["from_address"] not in filters["from_address"]
138	    ):
139	        return False
140	    if (
141	        filters["to_address"] is not None
142	        and record["to_address"] not in filters["to_address"]
143	    ):
144	        return False
145	    if (
146	        filters["method"] is not None
147	        and record["method"] not in filters["method"]
148	    ):
149	        return False
150	    ts = record["timestamp"]
151	    if filters["start_time"] is not None and ts < filters["start_time"]:
152	        return False
153	    if filters["end_time"] is not None and ts > filters["end_time"]:
154	        return False
155	    return True

163	class TxIndexer:
164	    """内存中的交易索引（无额外持久化）。"""
165	
166	    def __init__(self, records):
167	        # 加载顺序保留；查询时统一排序，不修改入参列表语义
168	        self._records = list(records)
169	
170	    def append_records(self, records):
171	        """追加已校验记录（增量导入用），保持追加顺序。
172	
173	        追加后查询与聚合立即可见新记录；既有记录的顺序与内容不变，
174	        已签发的分页游标语义不受影响。
175	        """
176	        self._records.extend(records)
177	
178	    def replace_records(self, remove_hashes, records):
179	        """删除指定 tx_hash 的记录后追加新记录（链重组替换用）。
180	
181	        仅删除 ``remove_hashes`` 中的记录，其余记录（含更低高度前缀
182	        以及内容完全相同、被保留的旧记录）原样保留，再按给定顺序追加
183	        新记录。替换后查询与全部统计入口立即只观察替换后的数据，排序
184	        仍在查询时统一进行。
185	        """
186	        if remove_hashes:
187	            self._records = [
188	                r for r in self._records if r["tx_hash"] not in remove_hashes
189	            ]
190	        self._records.extend(records)
191	
192	    def _matched(self, filters):
193	        matched = [r for r in self._records if _matches(r, filters)]
194	        matched.sort(key=lambda r: (r["block_number"], r["tx_hash"]))
195	        return matched
196	
197	    @staticmethod
198	    def _validate_page_size(page_size):
199	        if (
200	            not isinstance(page_size, int)
201	            or isinstance(page_size, bool)
202	            or page_size < 1
203	            or page_size > MAX_PAGE_SIZE
204	        ):
205	            raise InvalidPageSizeError(
206	                "page_size 必须为 1 到 %d 之间的整数（默认 %d）"
207	                % (MAX_PAGE_SIZE, DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE),
208	                None,
209	            )
210	
211	    def query(self, filters, page_size=DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE, cursor=None):
212	        """分页查询。返回 {transactions, total, next_cursor}。"""
213	        self._validate_page_size(page_size)
214	
215	        matched = self._matched(filters)
216	        total = len(matched)
217	
218	        start = 0
219	        if cursor is not None:
220	            after_block, after_tx_hash = decode_cursor(cursor, filters)
221	            # keyset 续页：排序键严格大于 marker 的第一个位置。
222	            # marker 位于两键之间也安全（bisect 取下一键），不会跳过或重复。
223	            keys = [(r["block_number"], r["tx_hash"]) for r in matched]
224	            start = bisect.bisect_left(keys, (after_block, after_tx_hash))
225	            if start < total and keys[start] == (after_block, after_tx_hash):
226	                # marker 命中现存记录本身：从其后一条开始
227	                start += 1
228	
229	        end = start + page_size
230	        page = matched[start:end]
231	        if end < total:
232	            last = page[-1]
233	            next_cursor = encode_cursor(
234	                filters, last["block_number"], last["tx_hash"]
235	            )
236	        else:
237	            next_cursor = None
238	
239	        return {
240	            "transactions": [to_public(r) for r in page],
241	            "total": total,
242	            "next_cursor": next_cursor,
243	        }
244	
245	    def stats(self, filters):
246	        """聚合统计（忽略分页）。"""
247	        total_amount = 0
248	        min_amount = None
249	        max_amount = None
250	        count = 0
251	        for record in self._records:
252	            if not _matches(record, filters):
253	                continue
254	            value = int(record["amount"])
255	            count += 1
256	            total_amount += value
257	            if min_amount is None or value < min_amount:
258	                min_amount = value
259	            if max_amount is None or value > max_amount:
260	                max_amount = value
261	
262	        if count == 0:
263	            return {
264	                "total_count": 0,
265	                "total_amount": "0",
266	                "min_amount": None,
267	                "max_amount": None,
268	                "avg_amount": None,
269	            }
270	        return {
271	            "total_count": count,
272	            "total_amount": str(total_amount),
273	            "min_amount": str(min_amount),
274	            "max_amount": str(max_amount),
275	            "avg_amount": str(total_amount // count),
276	        }

278	    def method_stats(self, filters, page_size=DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE, cursor=None):
279	        """按 method 分组的分页统计。
280	
281	        返回 {groups, total_groups, next_cursor}；每组含 method、
282	        total_count、total_amount、avg_amount（金额为十进制整数字符串，
283	        平均值向下取整）。顺序：total_amount 降序、total_count 降序、
284	        method 的 Unicode 码点升序。
285	        """
286	        self._validate_page_size(page_size)
287	
288	        totals = {}
289	        counts = {}
290	        for record in self._records:
291	            if not _matches(record, filters):
292	                continue
293	            method = record["method"]
294	            totals[method] = totals.get(method, 0) + int(record["amount"])
295	            counts[method] = counts.get(method, 0) + 1
296	
297	        # (-total, -count, method) 升序即 total/count 降序、method 升序，
298	        # 同时得到可直接 bisect 的单调递增键
299	        methods = sorted(
300	            totals, key=lambda m: (-totals[m], -counts[m], m)
301	        )
302	        total_groups = len(methods)
303	
304	        start = 0
305	        if cursor is not None:
306	            (
307	                after_total,
308	                after_count,
309	                after_method,
310	            ) = decode_method_stats_cursor(cursor, filters)
311	            keys = [(-totals[m], -counts[m], m) for m in methods]
312	            marker = (-after_total, -after_count, after_method)
313	            # keyset 续页：排序键严格大于 marker 的第一个位置。
314	            # marker 位于两键之间也安全（bisect 取下一键），不会跳过或重复。
315	            start = bisect.bisect_left(keys, marker)
316	            if start < total_groups and keys[start] == marker:
317	                # marker 命中现存分组本身：从其后一组开始
318	                start += 1
319	
320	        end = start + page_size
321	        page_methods = methods[start:end]
322	        groups = [
323	            {
324	                "method": method,
325	                "total_count": counts[method],
326	                "total_amount": str(totals[method]),
327	                "avg_amount": str(totals[method] // counts[method]),
328	            }
329	            for method in page_methods
330	        ]
331	        if end < total_groups:
332	            last = page_methods[-1]
333	            next_cursor = encode_method_stats_cursor(
334	                filters, totals[last], counts[last], last
335	            )
336	        else:
337	            next_cursor = None
338	
339	        return {
340	            "groups": groups,
341	            "total_groups": total_groups,
342	            "next_cursor": next_cursor,
343	        }

345	    def address_stats(self, filters, page_size=DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE, cursor=None):
346	        """按参与地址分组的分页统计。
347	
348	        每条匹配交易以 from_address、to_address 的原字符串分别记一次
349	        发送、接收参与；自转账（from == to）的 total_count 只计一次，
350	        send_count / receive_count 各加一，金额只累计一次。
351	
352	        返回 {groups, total_groups, next_cursor}；每组含 address、
353	        send_count、receive_count、total_count、total_amount、avg_amount
354	        （金额为十进制整数字符串，平均值向下取整）。顺序：total_amount
355	        降序、total_count 降序、send_count 降序、receive_count 降序、
356	        address 的 Unicode 码点升序。
357	        """
358	        self._validate_page_size(page_size)
359	
360	        totals = {}
361	        send_counts = {}
362	        receive_counts = {}
363	        total_counts = {}
364	        for record in self._records:
365	            if not _matches(record, filters):
366	                continue
367	            value = int(record["amount"])
368	            frm = record["from_address"]
369	            to = record["to_address"]
370	
371	            totals[frm] = totals.get(frm, 0) + value
372	            send_counts[frm] = send_counts.get(frm, 0) + 1
373	            total_counts[frm] = total_counts.get(frm, 0) + 1
374	            receive_counts.setdefault(frm, 0)
375	
376	            if to == frm:
377	                # 自转账：total_count 不重复计、金额不重复累计，
378	                # 但发送、接收两个身份各加一
379	                receive_counts[to] += 1
380	            else:
381	                totals[to] = totals.get(to, 0) + value
382	                receive_counts[to] = receive_counts.get(to, 0) + 1
383	                total_counts[to] = total_counts.get(to, 0) + 1
384	                send_counts.setdefault(to, 0)
385	
386	        # (-total, -total_count, -send, -receive, address) 升序即各数值
387	        # 降序、address 升序，同时得到可直接 bisect 的单调递增键
388	        addresses = sorted(
389	            totals,
390	            key=lambda a: (
391	                -totals[a],
392	                -total_counts[a],
393	                -send_counts[a],
394	                -receive_counts[a],
395	                a,
396	            ),
397	        )
398	        total_groups = len(addresses)
399	
400	        start = 0
401	        if cursor is not None:
402	            (
403	                after_total,
404	                after_total_count,
405	                after_send,
406	                after_receive,
407	                after_address,
408	            ) = decode_address_stats_cursor(cursor, filters)
409	            keys = [
410	                (
411	                    -totals[a],
412	                    -total_counts[a],
413	                    -send_counts[a],
414	                    -receive_counts[a],
415	                    a,
416	                )
417	                for a in addresses
418	            ]
419	            marker = (
420	                -after_total,
421	                -after_total_count,
422	                -after_send,
423	                -after_receive,
424	                after_address,
425	            )
426	            # keyset 续页：排序键严格大于 marker 的第一个位置。
427	            # marker 位于两键之间也安全（bisect 取下一键），不会跳过或重复。
428	            start = bisect.bisect_left(keys, marker)
429	            if start < total_groups and keys[start] == marker:
430	                # marker 命中现存分组本身：从其后一组开始
431	                start += 1
432	
433	        end = start + page_size
434	        page_addresses = addresses[start:end]
435	        groups = [
436	            {
437	                "address": address,
438	                "send_count": send_counts[address],
439	                "receive_count": receive_counts[address],
440	                "total_count": total_counts[address],
441	                "total_amount": str(totals[address]),
442	                "avg_amount": str(totals[address] // total_counts[address]),
443	            }
444	            for address in page_addresses
445	        ]
446	        if end < total_groups:
447	            last = page_addresses[-1]
448	            next_cursor = encode_address_stats_cursor(
449	                filters,
450	                totals[last],
451	                total_counts[last],
452	                send_counts[last],
453	                receive_counts[last],
454	                last,
455	            )
456	        else:
457	            next_cursor = None
458	
459	        return {
460	            "groups": groups,
461	            "total_groups": total_groups,
462	            "next_cursor": next_cursor,
463	        }

530	        counterparties = sorted(
531	            totals,
532	            key=lambda c: (
533	                -totals[c],
534	                -total_counts[c],
535	                -send_counts[c],
536	                -receive_counts[c],

538	            ),

550	            ) = decode_counterparty_stats_cursor(cursor, filters)
551	            keys = [

556	                    -receive_counts[c],
557	                    c,
558	                )

568	            # keyset 续页：排序键严格大于 marker 的第一个位置。

"""查询、游标分页与聚合统计引擎。

筛选条件（不同条件之间取交集，均可省略）：
- ``address``：精确匹配 from_address 或 to_address（不可与
  ``from_address`` / ``to_address`` 并用）
- ``from_address`` / ``to_address`` / ``method``：值集合，集合内部
  任一命中即可；可重复给定，重复值等同一个条件
- ``start_time`` / ``end_time``：时间窗，左闭右闭（UTC 秒）

query 排序：block_number 升序，同高度按 tx_hash 升序。
method-stats 排序：total_amount 降序、total_count 降序、method 码点升序。
address-stats 排序：total_amount 降序、total_count 降序、send_count 降序、
receive_count 降序、address 码点升序。
counterparty-stats 排序键与 address-stats 相同，末级改为 counterparty
码点升序；每笔匹配交易只归入一个对手（发送方为观察地址时归
to_address，接收方为观察地址时归 from_address，自转账归观察地址本身）。
time-stats 把匹配交易按从 Unix 纪元对齐、左闭右开的固定宽度时间区间
分桶，只返回非空区间，按 bucket_start 升序分页。
pair-stats 把匹配交易按 from_address 到 to_address 的原字符串有向
组合分组（自转账也累计一次），顺序为 total_amount 降序、total_count
降序、from_address 码点升序、to_address 码点升序。
address-time-stats 先按从 Unix 纪元对齐、左闭右开的固定宽度时间区间
分桶，再按参与地址在各区间内聚合（口径与 address-stats 相同），只
返回非空（区间, 地址）组，顺序为 bucket_start 升序、total_amount
降序、total_count 降序、send_count 降序、receive_count 降序、
address 码点升序。
分页：不透明 keyset 游标（见 :mod:`tx_indexer.cursor`），相同命令与
筛选下不跳过、不重复、不乱序；``total`` / ``total_groups`` 始终为
全部匹配数 / 全部分组数。
"""

import bisect

from .cursor import (
    decode_address_stats_cursor,
    decode_address_time_stats_cursor,
    decode_counterparty_stats_cursor,
    decode_cursor,
    decode_method_stats_cursor,
    decode_pair_stats_cursor,
    decode_time_stats_cursor,
    encode_address_stats_cursor,
    encode_address_time_stats_cursor,
    encode_counterparty_stats_cursor,
    encode_cursor,
    encode_method_stats_cursor,
    encode_pair_stats_cursor,
    encode_time_stats_cursor,
)
from .errors import (
    InvalidBucketSizeError,
    InvalidFilterError,
    InvalidPageSizeError,
    InvalidTimeRangeError,
)

DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 100
MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 1000

_PUBLIC_FIELDS = (
    "tx_hash",
    "block_number",
    "timestamp",
    "from_address",
    "to_address",
    "method",
    "amount",
)


def _normalize_value_set(name, values):
    """把单个值或值迭代器归一化为去重后的 frozenset；空集合返回 None。"""
    if values is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(values, str):
        values = (values,)
    result = set()
    for value in values:
        if not isinstance(value, str) or value.strip() == "":
            raise InvalidFilterError(
                "%s 筛选值不能为空或仅含空白" % name, None
            )
        result.add(value)
    if not result:
        return None
    return frozenset(result)


def normalize_filters(address=None, method=None, start_time=None, end_time=None,
                      from_address=None, to_address=None):
    """校验并归一化筛选条件。

    ``method`` / ``from_address`` / ``to_address`` 接受单个字符串或
    字符串迭代器，归一化为去重集合（frozenset）；不给或为空则为 None。
    """
    if address is not None and (
        not isinstance(address, str) or address.strip() == ""
    ):
        raise InvalidFilterError(
            "address 筛选值不能为空或仅含空白", None
        )
    from_set = _normalize_value_set("from_address", from_address)
    to_set = _normalize_value_set("to_address", to_address)
    method_set = _normalize_value_set("method", method)
    if address is not None and (from_set is not None or to_set is not None):
        raise InvalidFilterError(
            "address 不能与 from_address / to_address 同时使用", None
        )
    for name, value in (("start_time", start_time), ("end_time", end_time)):
        if value is not None and (
            not isinstance(value, int) or isinstance(value, bool) or value < 0
        ):
            raise ValueError("%s 必须为非负整数" % name)
    if start_time is not None and end_time is not None and start_time > end_time:
        raise InvalidTimeRangeError(
            "时间窗倒置：start_time(%d) 大于 end_time(%d)"
            % (start_time, end_time),
            None,
        )
    return {
        "address": address,
        "from_address": from_set,
        "to_address": to_set,
        "method": method_set,
        "start_time": start_time,
        "end_time": end_time,
    }


def _matches(record, filters):
    if filters["address"] is not None:
        addr = filters["address"]
        if record["from_address"] != addr and record["to_address"] != addr:
            return False
    if (
        filters["from_address"] is not None
        and record["from_address"] not in filters["from_address"]
    ):
        return False
    if (
        filters["to_address"] is not None
        and record["to_address"] not in filters["to_address"]
    ):
        return False
    if (
        filters["method"] is not None
        and record["method"] not in filters["method"]
    ):
        return False
    ts = record["timestamp"]
    if filters["start_time"] is not None and ts < filters["start_time"]:
        return False
    if filters["end_time"] is not None and ts > filters["end_time"]:
        return False
    return True


def to_public(record):
    """按公开字段顺序输出一条交易。"""
    return {name: record[name] for name in _PUBLIC_FIELDS}


class TxIndexer:
    """内存中的交易索引（无额外持久化）。"""

    def __init__(self, records):
        # 加载顺序保留；查询时统一排序，不修改入参列表语义
        self._records = list(records)

    def append_records(self, records):
        """追加已校验记录（增量导入用），保持追加顺序。

        追加后查询与聚合立即可见新记录；既有记录的顺序与内容不变，
        已签发的分页游标语义不受影响。
        """
        self._records.extend(records)

    def replace_records(self, remove_hashes, records):
        """删除指定 tx_hash 的记录后追加新记录（链重组替换用）。

        仅删除 ``remove_hashes`` 中的记录，其余记录（含更低高度前缀
        以及内容完全相同、被保留的旧记录）原样保留，再按给定顺序追加
        新记录。替换后查询与全部统计入口立即只观察替换后的数据，排序
        仍在查询时统一进行。
        """
        if remove_hashes:
            self._records = [
                r for r in self._records if r["tx_hash"] not in remove_hashes
            ]
        self._records.extend(records)

    def _matched(self, filters):
        matched = [r for r in self._records if _matches(r, filters)]
        matched.sort(key=lambda r: (r["block_number"], r["tx_hash"]))
        return matched

    @staticmethod
    def _validate_page_size(page_size):
        if (
            not isinstance(page_size, int)
            or isinstance(page_size, bool)
            or page_size < 1
            or page_size > MAX_PAGE_SIZE
        ):
            raise InvalidPageSizeError(
                "page_size 必须为 1 到 %d 之间的整数（默认 %d）"
                % (MAX_PAGE_SIZE, DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE),
                None,
            )

    def query(self, filters, page_size=DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE, cursor=None):
        """分页查询。返回 {transactions, total, next_cursor}。"""
        self._validate_page_size(page_size)

        matched = self._matched(filters)
        total = len(matched)

        start = 0
        if cursor is not None:
            after_block, after_tx_hash = decode_cursor(cursor, filters)
            # keyset 续页：排序键严格大于 marker 的第一个位置。
            # marker 位于两键之间也安全（bisect 取下一键），不会跳过或重复。
            keys = [(r["block_number"], r["tx_hash"]) for r in matched]
            start = bisect.bisect_left(keys, (after_block, after_tx_hash))
            if start < total and keys[start] == (after_block, after_tx_hash):
                # marker 命中现存记录本身：从其后一条开始
                start += 1

        end = start + page_size
        page = matched[start:end]
        if end < total:
            last = page[-1]
            next_cursor = encode_cursor(
                filters, last["block_number"], last["tx_hash"]
            )
        else:
            next_cursor = None

        return {
            "transactions": [to_public(r) for r in page],
            "total": total,
            "next_cursor": next_cursor,
        }

    def stats(self, filters):
        """聚合统计（忽略分页）。"""
        total_amount = 0
        min_amount = None
        max_amount = None
        count = 0
        for record in self._records:
            if not _matches(record, filters):
                continue
            value = int(record["amount"])
            count += 1
            total_amount += value
            if min_amount is None or value < min_amount:
                min_amount = value
            if max_amount is None or value > max_amount:
                max_amount = value

        if count == 0:
            return {
                "total_count": 0,
                "total_amount": "0",
                "min_amount": None,
                "max_amount": None,
                "avg_amount": None,
            }
        return {
            "total_count": count,
            "total_amount": str(total_amount),
            "min_amount": str(min_amount),
            "max_amount": str(max_amount),
            "avg_amount": str(total_amount // count),
        }

    def method_stats(self, filters, page_size=DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE, cursor=None):
        """按 method 分组的分页统计。

        返回 {groups, total_groups, next_cursor}；每组含 method、
        total_count、total_amount、avg_amount（金额为十进制整数字符串，
        平均值向下取整）。顺序：total_amount 降序、total_count 降序、
        method 的 Unicode 码点升序。
        """
        self._validate_page_size(page_size)

        totals = {}
        counts = {}
        for record in self._records:
            if not _matches(record, filters):
                continue
            method = record["method"]
            totals[method] = totals.get(method, 0) + int(record["amount"])
            counts[method] = counts.get(method, 0) + 1

        # (-total, -count, method) 升序即 total/count 降序、method 升序，
        # 同时得到可直接 bisect 的单调递增键
        methods = sorted(
            totals, key=lambda m: (-totals[m], -counts[m], m)
        )
        total_groups = len(methods)

        start = 0
        if cursor is not None:
            (
                after_total,
                after_count,
                after_method,
            ) = decode_method_stats_cursor(cursor, filters)
            keys = [(-totals[m], -counts[m], m) for m in methods]
            marker = (-after_total, -after_count, after_method)
            # keyset 续页：排序键严格大于 marker 的第一个位置。
            # marker 位于两键之间也安全（bisect 取下一键），不会跳过或重复。
            start = bisect.bisect_left(keys, marker)
            if start < total_groups and keys[start] == marker:
                # marker 命中现存分组本身：从其后一组开始
                start += 1

        end = start + page_size
        page_methods = methods[start:end]
        groups = [
            {
                "method": method,
                "total_count": counts[method],
                "total_amount": str(totals[method]),
                "avg_amount": str(totals[method] // counts[method]),
            }
            for method in page_methods
        ]
        if end < total_groups:
            last = page_methods[-1]
            next_cursor = encode_method_stats_cursor(
                filters, totals[last], counts[last], last
            )
        else:
            next_cursor = None

        return {
            "groups": groups,
            "total_groups": total_groups,
            "next_cursor": next_cursor,
        }

    def address_stats(self, filters, page_size=DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE, cursor=None):
        """按参与地址分组的分页统计。

        每条匹配交易以 from_address、to_address 的原字符串分别记一次
        发送、接收参与；自转账（from == to）的 total_count 只计一次，
        send_count / receive_count 各加一，金额只累计一次。

        返回 {groups, total_groups, next_cursor}；每组含 address、
        send_count、receive_count、total_count、total_amount、avg_amount
        （金额为十进制整数字符串，平均值向下取整）。顺序：total_amount
        降序、total_count 降序、send_count 降序、receive_count 降序、
        address 的 Unicode 码点升序。
        """
        self._validate_page_size(page_size)

        totals = {}
        send_counts = {}
        receive_counts = {}
        total_counts = {}
        for record in self._records:
            if not _matches(record, filters):
                continue
            value = int(record["amount"])
            frm = record["from_address"]
            to = record["to_address"]

            totals[frm] = totals.get(frm, 0) + value
            send_counts[frm] = send_counts.get(frm, 0) + 1
            total_counts[frm] = total_counts.get(frm, 0) + 1
            receive_counts.setdefault(frm, 0)

            if to == frm:
                # 自转账：total_count 不重复计、金额不重复累计，
                # 但发送、接收两个身份各加一
                receive_counts[to] += 1
            else:
                totals[to] = totals.get(to, 0) + value
                receive_counts[to] = receive_counts.get(to, 0) + 1
                total_counts[to] = total_counts.get(to, 0) + 1
                send_counts.setdefault(to, 0)

        # (-total, -total_count, -send, -receive, address) 升序即各数值
        # 降序、address 升序，同时得到可直接 bisect 的单调递增键
        addresses = sorted(
            totals,
            key=lambda a: (
                -totals[a],
                -total_counts[a],
                -send_counts[a],
                -receive_counts[a],
                a,
            ),
        )
        total_groups = len(addresses)

        start = 0
        if cursor is not None:
            (
                after_total,
                after_total_count,
                after_send,
                after_receive,
                after_address,
            ) = decode_address_stats_cursor(cursor, filters)
            keys = [
                (
                    -totals[a],
                    -total_counts[a],
                    -send_counts[a],
                    -receive_counts[a],
                    a,
                )
                for a in addresses
            ]
            marker = (
                -after_total,
                -after_total_count,
                -after_send,
                -after_receive,
                after_address,
            )
            # keyset 续页：排序键严格大于 marker 的第一个位置。
            # marker 位于两键之间也安全（bisect 取下一键），不会跳过或重复。
            start = bisect.bisect_left(keys, marker)
            if start < total_groups and keys[start] == marker:
                # marker 命中现存分组本身：从其后一组开始
                start += 1

        end = start + page_size
        page_addresses = addresses[start:end]
        groups = [
            {
                "address": address,
                "send_count": send_counts[address],
                "receive_count": receive_counts[address],
                "total_count": total_counts[address],
                "total_amount": str(totals[address]),
                "avg_amount": str(totals[address] // total_counts[address]),
            }
            for address in page_addresses
        ]
        if end < total_groups:
            last = page_addresses[-1]
            next_cursor = encode_address_stats_cursor(
                filters,
                totals[last],
                total_counts[last],
                send_counts[last],
                receive_counts[last],
                last,
            )
        else:
            next_cursor = None

        return {
            "groups": groups,
            "total_groups": total_groups,
            "next_cursor": next_cursor,
        }

    def counterparty_stats(self, filters, page_size=DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE,
                           cursor=None):
        """按交易对手分页汇总（必须给定 address 筛选作为观察地址）。

        只统计发送方或接收方为观察地址的匹配交易，且每笔交易只归一个
        对手：发送方为观察地址时归入 to_address，接收方为观察地址时归
        入 from_address；自转账以观察地址自身为对手，total_count 只计
        一次、send_count / receive_count 各加一、金额只累计一次。
        各分组的 send_count / receive_count / total_count / 金额口径与
        address-stats 相同（从对手视角计发送/接收）。

        返回 {address, groups, total_groups, next_cursor}；每组含
        counterparty、send_count、receive_count、total_count、
        total_amount、avg_amount（金额为十进制整数字符串，平均值向下
        取整）。顺序：total_amount 降序、total_count 降序、send_count
        降序、receive_count 降序、counterparty 的 Unicode 码点升序。
        """
        self._validate_page_size(page_size)
        address = filters["address"]
        if address is None:
            raise InvalidFilterError(
                "counterparty-stats 必须给定 address 筛选", None
            )

        totals = {}
        send_counts = {}
        receive_counts = {}
        total_counts = {}
        for record in self._records:
            if not _matches(record, filters):
                continue
            value = int(record["amount"])
            frm = record["from_address"]
            to = record["to_address"]

            if frm == to:
                # 自转账：对手即观察地址本身，两个身份各加一，
                # total_count 与金额只计一次
                counterparty = frm
                send_counts[counterparty] = (
                    send_counts.get(counterparty, 0) + 1
                )
                receive_counts[counterparty] = (
                    receive_counts.get(counterparty, 0) + 1
                )
            elif frm == address:
                # 观察地址发出：对手为接收方，记一次接收
                counterparty = to
                send_counts.setdefault(counterparty, 0)
                receive_counts[counterparty] = (
                    receive_counts.get(counterparty, 0) + 1
                )
            else:
                # 观察地址接收：对手为发送方，记一次发送
                counterparty = frm
                send_counts[counterparty] = (
                    send_counts.get(counterparty, 0) + 1
                )
                receive_counts.setdefault(counterparty, 0)

            totals[counterparty] = totals.get(counterparty, 0) + value
            total_counts[counterparty] = total_counts.get(counterparty, 0) + 1

        # (-total, -total_count, -send, -receive, counterparty) 升序即各
        # 数值降序、counterparty 升序，同时得到可直接 bisect 的单调递增键
        counterparties = sorted(
            totals,
            key=lambda c: (
                -totals[c],
                -total_counts[c],
                -send_counts[c],
                -receive_counts[c],
                c,
            ),
        )
        total_groups = len(counterparties)

        start = 0
        if cursor is not None:
            (
                after_total,
                after_total_count,
                after_send,
                after_receive,
                after_counterparty,
            ) = decode_counterparty_stats_cursor(cursor, filters)
            keys = [
                (
                    -totals[c],
                    -total_counts[c],
                    -send_counts[c],
                    -receive_counts[c],
                    c,
                )
                for c in counterparties
            ]
            marker = (
                -after_total,
                -after_total_count,
                -after_send,
                -after_receive,
                after_counterparty,
            )
            # keyset 续页：排序键严格大于 marker 的第一个位置。
            # marker 位于两键之间也安全（bisect 取下一键），不会跳过或重复。
            start = bisect.bisect_left(keys, marker)
            if start < total_groups and keys[start] == marker:
                # marker 命中现存分组本身：从其后一组开始
                start += 1

        end = start + page_size
        page_counterparties = counterparties[start:end]
        groups = [
            {
                "counterparty": counterparty,
                "send_count": send_counts[counterparty],
                "receive_count": receive_counts[counterparty],
                "total_count": total_counts[counterparty],
                "total_amount": str(totals[counterparty]),
                "avg_amount": str(
                    totals[counterparty] // total_counts[counterparty]
                ),
            }
            for counterparty in page_counterparties
        ]
        if end < total_groups:
            last = page_counterparties[-1]
            next_cursor = encode_counterparty_stats_cursor(
                filters,
                totals[last],
                total_counts[last],
                send_counts[last],
                receive_counts[last],
                last,
            )
        else:
            next_cursor = None

        return {
            "address": address,
            "groups": groups,
            "total_groups": total_groups,
            "next_cursor": next_cursor,
        }

    @staticmethod
    def _validate_bucket_size(bucket_size):
        if (
            not isinstance(bucket_size, int)
            or isinstance(bucket_size, bool)
            or bucket_size < 1
        ):
            raise InvalidBucketSizeError(
                "bucket_size 必须为大于 0 的整数（秒）", None
            )

    def time_stats(self, filters, bucket_size, page_size=DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE,
                   cursor=None):
        """按固定宽度时间区间分桶的分页统计。

        区间从 Unix 纪元对齐、左闭右开：``bucket_start = (timestamp //
        bucket_size) * bucket_size``，``bucket_end_exclusive =
        bucket_start + bucket_size``；每笔匹配交易恰好进入一个区间。
        只返回有交易的区间，按 bucket_start 升序分页。

        返回 {groups, total_groups, next_cursor}；每组含 bucket_start、
        bucket_end_exclusive（均为 UTC 秒整数）、total_count、
        total_amount、avg_amount（金额为十进制整数字符串，平均值向下
        取整）。游标绑定本命令、等价筛选与 bucket_size，不绑定
        page_size。
        """
        self._validate_page_size(page_size)
        self._validate_bucket_size(bucket_size)

        totals = {}
        counts = {}
        for record in self._records:
            if not _matches(record, filters):
                continue
            bucket_start = (record["timestamp"] // bucket_size) * bucket_size
            totals[bucket_start] = (
                totals.get(bucket_start, 0) + int(record["amount"])
            )
            counts[bucket_start] = counts.get(bucket_start, 0) + 1

        starts = sorted(totals)
        total_groups = len(starts)

        start = 0
        if cursor is not None:
            after_bucket_start = decode_time_stats_cursor(
                cursor, filters, bucket_size
            )
            # keyset 续页：bucket_start 严格大于 marker 的第一个区间。
            # marker 位于两键之间也安全，不会跳过或重复。
            start = bisect.bisect_right(starts, after_bucket_start)

        end = start + page_size
        page_starts = starts[start:end]
        groups = [
            {
                "bucket_start": bucket_start,
                "bucket_end_exclusive": bucket_start + bucket_size,
                "total_count": counts[bucket_start],
                "total_amount": str(totals[bucket_start]),
                "avg_amount": str(totals[bucket_start] // counts[bucket_start]),
            }
            for bucket_start in page_starts
        ]
        if end < total_groups:
            next_cursor = encode_time_stats_cursor(
                filters, bucket_size, page_starts[-1]
            )
        else:
            next_cursor = None

        return {
            "groups": groups,
            "total_groups": total_groups,
            "next_cursor": next_cursor,
        }

    def pair_stats(self, filters, page_size=DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE, cursor=None):
        """按有向交易对（from_address → to_address）分组的分页统计。

        每条匹配交易按 from_address 到 to_address 的原字符串有向组合
        归入一组，自转账也累计一次。

        返回 {groups, total_groups, next_cursor}；每组含 from_address、
        to_address、total_count、total_amount、avg_amount（金额为十进制
        整数字符串，平均值向下取整）。顺序：total_amount 降序、
        total_count 降序、from_address 的 Unicode 码点升序、
        to_address 的 Unicode 码点升序。游标绑定本命令与等价筛选，
        不绑定 page_size。
        """
        self._validate_page_size(page_size)

        totals = {}
        counts = {}
        for record in self._records:
            if not _matches(record, filters):
                continue
            key = (record["from_address"], record["to_address"])
            totals[key] = totals.get(key, 0) + int(record["amount"])
            counts[key] = counts.get(key, 0) + 1

        # (-total, -count, from, to) 升序即 total/count 降序、from/to
        # 码点升序，同时得到可直接 bisect 的单调递增键
        pairs = sorted(
            totals, key=lambda p: (-totals[p], -counts[p], p[0], p[1])
        )
        total_groups = len(pairs)

        start = 0
        if cursor is not None:
            (
                after_total,
                after_count,
                after_from,
                after_to,
            ) = decode_pair_stats_cursor(cursor, filters)
            keys = [(-totals[p], -counts[p], p[0], p[1]) for p in pairs]
            marker = (-after_total, -after_count, after_from, after_to)
            # keyset 续页：排序键严格大于 marker 的第一个位置。
            # marker 位于两键之间也安全（bisect 取下一键），不会跳过或重复。
            start = bisect.bisect_left(keys, marker)
            if start < total_groups and keys[start] == marker:
                # marker 命中现存分组本身：从其后一组开始
                start += 1

        end = start + page_size
        page_pairs = pairs[start:end]
        groups = [
            {
                "from_address": frm,
                "to_address": to,
                "total_count": counts[(frm, to)],
                "total_amount": str(totals[(frm, to)]),
                "avg_amount": str(totals[(frm, to)] // counts[(frm, to)]),
            }
            for frm, to in page_pairs
        ]
        if end < total_groups:
            last_from, last_to = page_pairs[-1]
            next_cursor = encode_pair_stats_cursor(
                filters,
                totals[page_pairs[-1]],
                counts[page_pairs[-1]],
                last_from,
                last_to,
            )
        else:
            next_cursor = None

        return {
            "groups": groups,
            "total_groups": total_groups,
            "next_cursor": next_cursor,
        }

    def address_time_stats(self, filters, bucket_size,
                           page_size=DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE, cursor=None):
        """按时间区间 × 参与地址分组的分页统计。

        区间从 Unix 纪元对齐、左闭右开：``bucket_start = (timestamp //
        bucket_size) * bucket_size``，``bucket_end_exclusive =
        bucket_start + bucket_size``；每笔匹配交易恰好进入一个区间。
        区间内按 from_address、to_address 的原字符串分别记一次发送、
        接收参与（口径与 :meth:`address_stats` 相同）：from/to 不同时
        发送方组 send_count 加一、接收方组 receive_count 加一，两组
        total_count 各加一、金额各累计一次；自转账只进一个组，
        send_count / receive_count / total_count 各加一，金额累计一次。
        只返回非空（区间, 地址）组。

        返回 {groups, total_groups, next_cursor}；每组含 address、
        bucket_start、bucket_end_exclusive、send_count、receive_count、
        total_count、total_amount、avg_amount（金额为十进制整数字符串，
        平均值向下取整）。顺序：bucket_start 升序、total_amount 降序、
        total_count 降序、send_count 降序、receive_count 降序、
        address 的 Unicode 码点升序。游标绑定本命令、等价筛选与
        bucket_size，不绑定 page_size。
        """
        self._validate_page_size(page_size)
        self._validate_bucket_size(bucket_size)

        # key = (bucket_start, address)
        totals = {}
        send_counts = {}
        receive_counts = {}
        total_counts = {}
        for record in self._records:
            if not _matches(record, filters):
                continue
            value = int(record["amount"])
            bucket_start = (record["timestamp"] // bucket_size) * bucket_size
            frm = record["from_address"]
            to = record["to_address"]
            sender_key = (bucket_start, frm)
            totals[sender_key] = totals.get(sender_key, 0) + value
            send_counts[sender_key] = (
                send_counts.get(sender_key, 0) + 1
            )
            total_counts[sender_key] = (
                total_counts.get(sender_key, 0) + 1
            )
            receive_counts.setdefault(sender_key, 0)

            if to == frm:
                # 自转账：只进一个组，total_count 与金额不重复累计，
                # 但发送、接收两个身份各加一
                receive_counts[sender_key] += 1
            else:
                receiver_key = (bucket_start, to)
                totals[receiver_key] = totals.get(receiver_key, 0) + value
                receive_counts[receiver_key] = (
                    receive_counts.get(receiver_key, 0) + 1
                )
                total_counts[receiver_key] = (
                    total_counts.get(receiver_key, 0) + 1
                )
                send_counts.setdefault(receiver_key, 0)

        # (bucket_start, -total, -total_count, -send, -receive, address)
        # 升序即 bucket_start 升序，其后各数值降序、address 升序，
        # 同时得到可直接 bisect 的单调递增键
        group_keys = sorted(
            totals,
            key=lambda k: (
                k[0],
                -totals[k],
                -total_counts[k],
                -send_counts[k],
                -receive_counts[k],
                k[1],
            ),
        )
        total_groups = len(group_keys)

        start = 0
        if cursor is not None:
            (
                after_bucket_start,
                after_total,
                after_total_count,
                after_send,
                after_receive,
                after_address,
            ) = decode_address_time_stats_cursor(cursor, filters, bucket_size)
            keys = [
                (
                    k[0],
                    -totals[k],
                    -total_counts[k],
                    -send_counts[k],
                    -receive_counts[k],
                    k[1],
                )
                for k in group_keys
            ]
            marker = (
                after_bucket_start,
                -after_total,
                -after_total_count,
                -after_send,
                -after_receive,
                after_address,
            )
            # keyset 续页：排序键严格大于 marker 的第一个位置。
            # marker 位于两键之间也安全（bisect 取下一键），不会跳过或重复。
            start = bisect.bisect_left(keys, marker)
            if start < total_groups and keys[start] == marker:
                # marker 命中现存分组本身：从其后一组开始
                start += 1

        end = start + page_size
        page_keys = group_keys[start:end]
        groups = []
        for bucket_start, address in page_keys:
            total_amount = totals[(bucket_start, address)]
            total_count = total_counts[(bucket_start, address)]
            groups.append({
                "address": address,
                "bucket_start": bucket_start,
                "bucket_end_exclusive": bucket_start + bucket_size,
                "send_count": send_counts[(bucket_start, address)],
                "receive_count": receive_counts[(bucket_start, address)],
                "total_count": total_count,
                "total_amount": str(total_amount),
                "avg_amount": str(total_amount // total_count),
            })
        if end < total_groups:
            last_key = page_keys[-1]
            last_bucket_start, last_address = last_key
            next_cursor = encode_address_time_stats_cursor(
                filters,
                bucket_size,
                last_bucket_start,
                totals[last_key],
                total_counts[last_key],
                send_counts[last_key],
                receive_counts[last_key],
                last_address,
            )
        else:
            next_cursor = None

        return {
            "groups": groups,
            "total_groups": total_groups,
            "next_cursor": next_cursor,
        }

        help="按有向交易对分页汇总（返回 groups/total_groups/next_cursor）",
    )
    pair_stats_parser.add_argument("file", help="JSON Lines 数据文件路径")
    _add_filter_args(pair_stats_parser)
    pair_stats_parser.add_argument(
        "--page-size",
        default=str(DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE),
        help="每页分组数，1 到 1000，默认 100",
    )
    pair_stats_parser.add_argument(
        "--cursor", help="上一页返回的 next_cursor"
    )

    address_time_stats_parser = subparsers.add_parser(
        "address-time-stats",
        help="按时间区间 × 参与地址分页汇总"
             "（返回 groups/total_groups/next_cursor）",
    )
    address_time_stats_parser.add_argument(
        "file", help="JSON Lines 数据文件路径"
    )
    _add_filter_args(address_time_stats_parser)
    address_time_stats_parser.add_argument(
        "--bucket-size",
        help="区间宽度（秒），大于 0 的整数；区间从 Unix 纪元对齐、左闭右开",
    )
    address_time_stats_parser.add_argument(
        "--page-size",
        default=str(DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE),
        help="每页分组数，1 到 1000，默认 100",
    )
    address_time_stats_parser.add_argument(
        "--cursor", help="上一页返回的 next_cursor"
    )

    return parser


def _filters_from_args(args, parser):
    start_time = (
        _parse_time(args.start_time, "--start-time", parser)
        if args.start_time is not None
        else None
    )
    end_time = (
        _parse_time(args.end_time, "--end-time", parser)
        if args.end_time is not None
        else None
    )
    # 倒置校验集中在 normalize_filters，抛 InvalidTimeRangeError；
    # 空白值与 address/from/to 冲突也在此抛 InvalidFilterError，
    # 均发生在读取数据文件之前
    return normalize_filters(
        address=args.address,
        method=args.method,
        start_time=start_time,
        end_time=end_time,
        from_address=args.from_address,
        to_address=args.to_address,
    )


def main(argv=None):
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    try:
        filters = _filters_from_args(args, parser)
        page_size = None
        if args.command in (
            "query",
            "method-stats",
            "address-stats",
            "counterparty-stats",
            "time-stats",
            "pair-stats",
            "address-time-stats",
        ):
            page_size = _parse_page_size(args.page_size)
        bucket_size = None
        if args.command in ("time-stats", "address-time-stats"):
            # 缺失、非整数或不大于 0 都在读取数据文件前报 invalid_bucket_size
            bucket_size = _parse_bucket_size(args.bucket_size)
        if args.command == "counterparty-stats" and filters["address"] is None:
            # 缺少 --address 与空白值、address/from/to 冲突一样，
            # 都在读取数据文件前报 invalid_filter
            raise InvalidFilterError(
                "counterparty-stats 必须指定 --address", None
            )

        records = load_file(args.file)
        indexer = TxIndexer(records)

        if args.command == "query":
            result = indexer.query(
                filters, page_size=page_size, cursor=args.cursor
            )
        elif args.command == "method-stats":
            result = indexer.method_stats(
                filters, page_size=page_size, cursor=args.cursor
            )
        elif args.command == "address-stats":
            result = indexer.address_stats(
                filters, page_size=page_size, cursor=args.cursor
            )
        elif args.command == "counterparty-stats":
            result = indexer.counterparty_stats(
                filters, page_size=page_size, cursor=args.cursor
            )
        elif args.command == "time-stats":
            result = indexer.time_stats(
                filters, bucket_size, page_size=page_size, cursor=args.cursor
            )
        elif args.command == "pair-stats":
            result = indexer.pair_stats(
                filters, page_size=page_size, cursor=args.cursor
            )
        elif args.command == "address-time-stats":
            result = indexer.address_time_stats(
                filters, bucket_size, page_size=page_size, cursor=args.cursor
            )
        else:
            result = indexer.stats(filters)
    except TxIndexerError as exc:
        json.dump(exc.to_dict(), sys.stderr, ensure_ascii=False)
        sys.stderr.write("\n")
        return 2
    except OSError as exc:
        # 文件读取失败不属于五类领域错误，按普通 I/O 错误处理
        sys.stderr.write("无法读取数据文件 %s：%s\n" % (args.file, exc))
        return 2

    json.dump(result, sys.stdout, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    sys.stdout.write("\n")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

182	    def __init__(self, fetch_blocks=None, indexer=None):

184	            raise ValueError("fetch_blocks 必须可调用")

194	        self._commit_lock = threading.Lock()

196	    @property
197	    def indexer(self):
198	        """底层查询索引；提交成功写入的交易立即可查。"""
199	        return self._indexer

201	    def _get_chain(self, chain_id, create=False):
202	        if not create:
203	            return self._chains.get(chain_id)
204	        with self._registry_lock:
205	            chain = self._chains.get(chain_id)
206	            if chain is None:
207	                chain = {
208	                    # 该链已配置的起始区块（首次提交确定）
209	                    "start": None,
210	                    "committed_start": None,
211	                    "committed_end": None,
212	                    "last_batch_at": None,
213	                    # 提交串行化条件变量；running 表示有提交正在执行
214	                    "cv": threading.Condition(),

225	        已提交的重叠区块原样重放时按重复跳过（不新增、不改写）；上游
226	        不可用或交易冲突时，当前批次与后续批次不提交，前序已提交批次

229	        成功返回机器可读结果：

231	        ``{"status": "ok", "chain_id", "range_start", "range_end",
232	        "committed_start_block", "committed_end_block", "next_block",

246	        chain = self._get_chain(chain_id, create=True)

256	                # 已完全覆盖（含被相同范围的并发提交先行完成）：幂等返回
257	                if (

259	                    and start_block >= committed_start

266	                    )

268	                # 不允许提交低于该链已配置起始区块、又不与已提交区间

276	                    )

279	                effective_start = (
280	                    start_block if committed_end is None
281	                    else max(start_block, committed_end + 1)

283	
284	                # 缺口等待：续点必须紧接已提交水位，不允许越过尚未提交

300	                    # 区块形成更高水位

304	                        % (chain_id, start_block, end_block, next_pending)
305	                    )
306	
307	                # 获得执行权即钉住该链已配置的起始区块：即使首个批次
308	                # 失败，后来的高范围也不能从中间起跳越过未提交的低区块
309	                if configured is None:
310	                    chain["start"] = start_block

312	                break

314	        try:
315	            # 拉取上游在锁外进行（可能很慢），不阻塞同链状态查询；
316	            # 批次的校验、写入、水位推进在 _run 内按批原子提交
317	            batch_count, committed, skipped = self._run(
318	                chain, effective_start, end_block, batch_size, fetcher
319	            )
320	        finally:
321	            with cv:
322	                chain["running"] = False
323	                cv.notify_all()
324	
325	        return self._ok_result(
326	            chain_id, start_block, end_block,
327	            committed_end=chain["committed_end"],
328	            batch_count=batch_count, committed=committed,
329	            skipped=skipped, chain=chain,
330	        )
331	
332	    def _run(self, chain, run_start, end_block, batch_size, fetcher):
333	        """升序执行批次（调用前已取得该链的执行权 ``running``）。
334	
335	        返回 ``(执行批次数, 新增交易数, 重复跳过数)``。任何异常都只在
336	        完整批次边界生效：已成功的批次与水位保留，当前批不部分提交。
337	        """
338	        batch_count = 0
339	        committed_total = 0
340	        skipped_total = 0
341	        cursor = run_start
342	        while cursor <= end_block:
343	            batch_end = min(cursor + batch_size - 1, end_block)
344	
345	            # 1. 拉取本批区块（不持有跨链提交锁，避免不同链相互等待）；
346	            #    SourceUnavailableError 直接透出，此前批次已完整提交、
347	            #    水位有效，下次原样重放未完成范围即可
348	            blocks = fetcher(cursor, batch_end)
349	            if not isinstance(blocks, list) or not blocks:
350	                raise SourceUnavailableError(
351	                    "上游未返回区块区间 [%d, %d]" % (cursor, batch_end),
352	                    None,
353	                )
354	            by_height = {}
355	            for slot, block in enumerate(blocks):
356	                if not isinstance(block, dict):
357	                    raise ValueError(
358	                        "fetch_blocks 返回的 blocks[%d] 必须是对象" % slot
359	                    )
360	                height = block.get("block_number")
361	                if not _is_nonneg_int(height):
362	                    raise ValueError(
363	                        "fetch_blocks 返回的 blocks[%d] 缺少合法 block_number"
364	                        % slot
365	                    )
366	                raw_txs = block.get("transactions")
367	                if not isinstance(raw_txs, list):
368	                    raise ValueError(
369	                        "区块 %d 的 transactions 必须是数组" % height
370	                    )
371	                if height in by_height:
372	                    raise ValueError(
373	                        "fetch_blocks 对区块高度 %d 返回了多次" % height
374	                    )
375	                by_height[height] = raw_txs
376	
377	            expected = set(range(cursor, batch_end + 1))
378	            missing = expected - set(by_height)
379	            if missing:
380	                raise SourceUnavailableError(
381	                    "上游暂时无法返回区块：%s"
382	                    % ", ".join(str(h) for h in sorted(missing)),
383	                    None,
384	                )
385	            extra = set(by_height) - expected
386	            if extra:
387	                raise ValueError(
388	                    "fetch_blocks 返回了请求区间外的区块：%s"
389	                    % ", ".join(str(h) for h in sorted(extra))
390	                )
391	
392	            # 2/3. 跨链提交锁内完成「校验标准化 → 重复/冲突判定 →
393	            #    整批写入 → 水位推进」，使全局 tx_hash 台账、共享索引与
394	            #    链水位保持原子；任何失败都发生在写入之前，不留半批结果
395	            with self._commit_lock:
396	                normalized = []
397	                seen_in_batch = {}
398	                for height in range(cursor, batch_end + 1):
399	                    for index, raw in enumerate(by_height[height]):
400	                        tx = _normalize_transaction(raw, height, index)
401	                        tx_hash = tx["tx_hash"]
402	                        existing = self._ledger.get(tx_hash)
403	                        if existing is None:
404	                            existing = seen_in_batch.get(tx_hash)
405	                        if (
406	                            existing is not None
407	                            and not _same_identity(existing, tx)
408	                        ):
409	                            raise TransactionConflictError(
410	                                "tx_hash %s 已存在但标准化内容不一致"
411	                                % tx_hash,
412	                                None,
413	                            )
414	                        seen_in_batch.setdefault(tx_hash, tx)
415	                        normalized.append(tx)
416	
417	                # 重复哈希跳过、不覆盖首次写入结果
418	                new_records = []
419	                added_hashes = set()
420	                for tx in normalized:
421	                    tx_hash = tx["tx_hash"]
422	                    if tx_hash in self._ledger or tx_hash in added_hashes:
423	                        # 与已提交记录同哈希同内容，或本批内部的多余副本：
424	                        # 计重复、只写一次
425	                        skipped_total += 1
426	                        continue
427	                    self._ledger[tx_hash] = tx
428	                    added_hashes.add(tx_hash)
429	                    new_records.append(tx)
430	                if new_records:
431	                    self._indexer.append_records(new_records)
432	                committed_total += len(new_records)
433	
434	                # 4. 推进该链水位到本批末块，记录最近成功批次时间
435	                with chain["cv"]:
436	                    if chain["committed_end"] is None:
437	                        chain["start"] = cursor
438	                        chain["committed_start"] = cursor
439	                    chain["committed_end"] = batch_end
440	                    chain["last_batch_at"] = time.time()
441	
442	            batch_count += 1
443	            cursor = batch_end + 1
444	
445	        return batch_count, committed_total, skipped_total

448	    def _ok_result(chain_id, range_start, range_end, committed_end,
449	                   batch_count, committed, skipped, chain):
450	        committed_start = chain["committed_start"]
451	        return {
452	            "status": "ok",
453	            "chain_id": chain_id,
454	            "range_start": range_start,
455	            "range_end": range_end,
456	            "committed_start_block": committed_start,
457	            "committed_end_block": committed_end,
458	            "next_block": None if committed_end is None else committed_end + 1,
459	            "processed_batch_count": batch_count,
460	            "committed_count": committed,
461	            "skipped_count": skipped,
462	            "last_batch_committed_at": chain["last_batch_at"],

465	    def status(self, chain_id, start_block=None):
466	        """只读返回某条链的索引水位状态，不扫描交易明细、不改变索引。
467

469	        "committed_end_block", "next_block", "last_batch_committed_at"}``。
470	        尚未开始索引的链已提交区间为 ``None``，``next_block`` 等于本次
471	        传入的 ``start_block``，未传入时返回 ``None``（该链也未配置过
472	        起始区块）；已配置（曾提交）但因并发暂不可见等情况下回退到该链
473	        已配置的起始区块。
474	        """
475	        if not _is_nonempty_text(chain_id):
476	            raise ValueError("chain_id 必须为非空字符串")
477	        if start_block is not None and not _is_nonneg_int(start_block):
478	            raise ValueError("start_block 必须为非负整数")
479	
480	        chain = self._get_chain(chain_id)
481	        if chain is None:
482	            next_block = start_block
483	            return {
484	                "chain_id": chain_id,
485	                "committed_start_block": None,
486	                "committed_end_block": None,
487	                "next_block": next_block,
488	                "last_batch_committed_at": None,
489	            }
490	
491	        with chain["cv"]:
492	            committed_end = chain["committed_end"]
493	            if committed_end is None:
494	                # 尚未提交：优先用调用方给的起点，否则用已配置起点
495	                next_block = (
496	                    start_block if start_block is not None else chain["start"]
497	                )
498	                return {
499	                    "chain_id": chain_id,
500	                    "committed_start_block": None,
501	                    "committed_end_block": None,
502	                    "next_block": next_block,
503	                    "last_batch_committed_at": None,
504	                }
505	            return {
506	                "chain_id": chain_id,
507	                "committed_start_block": chain["committed_start"],
508	                "committed_end_block": committed_end,
509	                "next_block": committed_end + 1,
510	                "last_batch_committed_at": chain["last_batch_at"],
511	            }

514	def _query_chain_indexer(indexer, chain_id, filters, page_size, cursor):
515	    """在单链索引上执行 query，分页游标额外绑定 chain_id。
516	
517	    筛选、左闭右闭时间窗、排序（block_number、tx_hash 双升序）、返回
518	    结构与 :meth:`TxIndexer.query` 完全一致；区别仅在于游标使用
519	    multichain-query 作用域，跨链、跨命令或筛选不等价时复用抛
520	    InvalidCursorError。
521	    """
522	    indexer._validate_page_size(page_size)
523	
524	    matched = indexer._matched(filters)
525	    total = len(matched)
526	
527	    start = 0
528	    if cursor is not None:
529	        after_block, after_tx_hash = decode_multichain_query_cursor(
530	            cursor, chain_id, filters
531	        )
532	        # keyset 续页：排序键严格大于 marker 的第一个位置。
533	        # marker 位于两键之间也安全（bisect 取下一键），不会跳过或重复。
534	        keys = [(r["block_number"], r["tx_hash"]) for r in matched]
535	        start = bisect.bisect_left(keys, (after_block, after_tx_hash))
536	        if start < total and keys[start] == (after_block, after_tx_hash):
537	            # marker 命中现存记录本身：从其后一条开始
538	            start += 1
539	
540	    end = start + page_size
541	    page = matched[start:end]
542	    if end < total:
543	        last = page[-1]
544	        next_cursor = encode_multichain_query_cursor(
545	            chain_id, filters, last["block_number"], last["tx_hash"]
546	        )
547	    else:
548	        next_cursor = None
549	
550	    return {
551	        "transactions": [to_public(r) for r in page],
552	        "total": total,
553	        "next_cursor": next_cursor,
554	    }

557	class MultiChainReplayManager:
558	    """多个 chain_id 共用同一入口时按链隔离的提交、水位与查询管理器。
559	
560	    每条链在首次 :meth:`submit` 时惰性创建一个独立的
561	    :class:`ReplayManager`，因而拥有独立的交易身份台账、查询索引、
562	    已提交水位与同链并发串行化：
563	
564	    - 相同 tx_hash 在不同 chain_id 中属于不同交易：区块内容与查询结果
565	      按链独立，跨链同哈希既不按重复跳过，也不构成冲突；同链首次写入
566	      不被覆盖
567	    - :meth:`submit` 的升序分批、整批原子提交、重放跳过、
568	      :class:`~tx_indexer.errors.SourceUnavailableError` 续传、同哈希
569	      不同标准化内容抛 :class:`~tx_indexer.errors.TransactionConflictError`
570	      以及同链并发等待/合并全部沿用 :class:`ReplayManager`；异链提交
571	      互不阻塞
572	    - :meth:`query` / :meth:`stats` 的筛选、左闭右闭时间窗、排序与
573	      汇总口径沿用 :class:`~tx_indexer.engine.TxIndexer`；分页游标绑定
574	      query 命令、chain_id 与等价筛选
575	
576	    上游区块由构造参数 ``fetch_blocks`` 提供（签名同
577	    :class:`ReplayManager`），也可以在每次 :meth:`submit` 时通过同名
578	    参数覆盖；两处都没有可调用对象时 :meth:`submit` 抛 ValueError。
579	    """
580	
581	    def __init__(self, fetch_blocks=None):
582	        if fetch_blocks is not None and not callable(fetch_blocks):
583	            raise ValueError("fetch_blocks 必须可调用")
584	        self._fetch_blocks = fetch_blocks
585	        # chain_id -> 该链专属的 ReplayManager（首次提交时创建）
586	        self._managers = {}
587	        # 只保护 _managers 的创建/取链；各链并发由链内管理器自行串行
588	        self._registry_lock = threading.Lock()
589	
590	    def _get_manager(self, chain_id, create=False):
591	        if not create:
592	            return self._managers.get(chain_id)
593	        with self._registry_lock:
594	            manager = self._managers.get(chain_id)
595	            if manager is None:
596	                # 独立索引、独立 tx_hash 台账、独立水位与并发条件变量：
597	                # 跨链同哈希互不判重、互不冲突，异链提交也不共享锁
598	                manager = ReplayManager(self._fetch_blocks)
599	                self._managers[chain_id] = manager
600	            return manager
601	
602	    def submit(self, chain_id, start_block, end_block, batch_size,
603	               fetch_blocks=None):
604	        """提交某条链的 ``[start_block, end_block]``（闭区间、升序分批）。
605	
606	        校验顺序、错误类型、分批与原子提交语义、并发行为与返回字段与
607	        :meth:`ReplayManager.submit` 完全一致；身份判定与水位只在同一
608	        chain_id 内有效。``fetch_blocks`` 给定时覆盖构造函数提供的
609	        拉取函数；最终没有任何可调用拉取函数时抛 ValueError。
610	        """
611	        # 校验顺序沿用 ReplayManager：范围/批量 -> chain_id -> fetcher，
612	        # 全部通过后才创建该链管理器，非法请求不留下链状态
613	        _validate_range(start_block, end_block, batch_size)
614	        if not _is_nonempty_text(chain_id):
615	            raise ValueError("chain_id 必须为非空字符串")
616	        fetcher = fetch_blocks if fetch_blocks is not None else self._fetch_blocks
617	        if not callable(fetcher):
618	            raise ValueError("必须提供可调用的 fetch_blocks")
619	
620	        manager = self._get_manager(chain_id, create=True)
621	        return manager.submit(
622	            chain_id, start_block, end_block, batch_size,
623	            fetch_blocks=fetcher,
624	        )
625	
626	    def status(self, chain_id, start_block=None):
627	        """只读返回某条链的索引水位状态，字段与 :meth:`ReplayManager.status` 一致。
628	
629	        尚未开始的链不创建状态：已提交区间为 ``None``，``next_block``
630	        等于传入的 ``start_block``（未传入为 ``None``）。chain_id 空白
631	        或 start_block 为负抛 ValueError。
632	        """
633	        manager = self._get_manager(chain_id)
634	        if manager is None:
635	            # 用一次性管理器复用完全相同的校验与「未知链」返回口径，
636	            # 不注册链、不改变任何状态
637	            return ReplayManager().status(chain_id, start_block)
638	        return manager.status(chain_id, start_block)
639	
640	    def query(self, chain_id, filters, page_size=DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE, cursor=None):
641	        """按链分页查询，返回 ``{transactions, total, next_cursor}``。
642	
643	        筛选、左闭右闭时间窗、排序、返回结构沿用
644	        :meth:`TxIndexer.query`；游标额外绑定 chain_id，跨链或改筛选
645	        复用抛 :class:`~tx_indexer.errors.InvalidCursorError`，
646	        page_size 非法抛
647	        :class:`~tx_indexer.errors.InvalidPageSizeError`，筛选非法抛
648	        :class:`~tx_indexer.errors.InvalidFilterError` /
649	        :class:`~tx_indexer.errors.InvalidTimeRangeError`。尚未开始的
650	        链按空索引处理：transactions 为空、total 为 0、next_cursor 为
651	        None（携带与该链及筛选不匹配的游标仍抛 InvalidCursorError）。
652	        """
653	        if not _is_nonempty_text(chain_id):
654	            raise ValueError("chain_id 必须为非空字符串")
655	        manager = self._get_manager(chain_id)
656	        indexer = manager.indexer if manager is not None else TxIndexer([])
657	        return _query_chain_indexer(
658	            indexer, chain_id, filters, page_size, cursor
659	        )
660	
661	    def stats(self, chain_id, filters):
662	        """按链聚合统计，筛选与汇总口径沿用 :meth:`TxIndexer.stats`。
663	
664	        尚未开始的链返回无匹配结果（total_count 为 0、total_amount 为
665	        ``"0"``、min/max/avg 均为 None）。
666	        """
667	        if not _is_nonempty_text(chain_id):
668	            raise ValueError("chain_id 必须为非空字符串")
669	        manager = self._get_manager(chain_id)
670	        indexer = manager.indexer if manager is not None else TxIndexer([])
671	        return indexer.stats(filters)
